question: In the DoExpMenu context, does reading the low event byte through an unsigned-char lvalue reverse the equality CMP operand order relative to masking the unsigned word? Positive: original byte load and CMP CX,AX. Negative: same value and code length, but CMP AX,CX. This is a context-specific compiler observation.

expect.byte_lvalue@0: mov al, byte ptr [bp - 7]; cwde; mov cl, byte ptr [bp - 0x1c]; sub ch, ch; cmp cx, ax
expect.word_mask@0: mov al, byte ptr [bp - 7]; cwde; mov cl, byte ptr [bp - 0x1c]; sub ch, ch; cmp ax, cx
